Feature

Case activity tagging

You can now use custom tags for individual activities, comments, tasks, and actions on the Case Wall, and filter the wall view by those tags. This allows you to categorize specific observations and filter the timeline to view only the entries relevant to your investigation or team.

entry.title: November 06, 2026
entry.content:
Agent Registry

Feature

Skill security scanning and governance in Agent Registry are available. You can automatically scan standalone skill revisions for security issues, review Finding resources, enforce scanning policies across your organization using custom Organization Policy constraints, and grant least-privilege skill management access.

You can also protect skill payloads at rest with customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK) (Preview).

For more information, see Scan skills for security issues, Configure CMEK for skills, and Agent Registry roles and permissions.

Feature

Standalone skills in Agent Registry are generally available (GA). You can register, version, search, and govern standalone
